task.title: Save profile changes
task.shortdesc: Create the first saved profile from a draft or persist changes to an existing profile.

prereq.p: Open BPM in the browser and keep a profile, Library, All Settings, Guided, JSON, or Compare surface available.

context.p: Saving establishes the profile ID for a new draft and makes the latest policy and managed-preference values available to other BPM surfaces.

step.cmd: Review the profile name, schema channel, and validation state before saving.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Select Save on the active editor surface.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: Wait for the visible status message that confirms the save completed.

info.p: Expected result: BPM keeps the selected profile, editor surface, locale, and theme clear while you work.

step.cmd: If validation or connection feedback appears, read it before navigating away or retrying.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: The profile has a saved state that can be reopened, validated, exported, or compared.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
